caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object depicted is a long, metallic corkscrew or auger with a roughly textured, rusted brown surface. It has a looped handle at the upper end, which is irregularly shaped, and a straight shaft that extends downward. The lower end of the object transitions into a spiral, helical blade for boring, rendered in a darker brown with visible shadows and subtle highlights to indicate its three-dimensional form. The corkscrew is oriented diagonally from the upper left to the lower right of the composition. There is a small printed inscription in the lower left quadrant that reads "Berlin, Stempel 1838."
title: Ship Builder's Auger
